subject: re-doc
title: RE.DOC.------POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 446 (EXT.F(II)-8). RE-DOC (redocumentation) is the subject; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner in the title but is not drawn as a label; the line from the subject's dot runs to PROG-CONT. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation), VT-PLT (vibrational platform) and COS-P (cosmic particulars). From S-ST: TR-INFO (trans-information). From VT-PLT: MT-TFS-AT (multi-transfer shift activity) and EXT-F (extended functionalism). From EXT-F: INFO-DS (information dissemination). From COS-P: PHY-U-C (physical universe context). From PHY-U-C: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: MOT-DY. The page text speaks of "The basic vibrational platform of the seventies".
